Kids Brand Safety Rules

* Content must NOT direct bad intention at any child featured in the content. Keep every clip warm, fun, and wholesome.
* Pranks must be light-hearted and harmless — the fun is the toy's silly dancing, never at a child's expense.


Important Notes
* In-store date is 26 October; the pre-order window is live ahead of it.

THEME PAGES
